title: PVZ Fusion Cheats
description:
Check out the new version of Plants vs Zombies – everything is new here, but the classics are still there!

Now you can not only fight off zombies with the help of your green friends, but also make cool hybrid plants. These are plants that combine the powers of two or even more ordinary plants.

With these hybrids, you'll get a bunch of new chips to deal with zombies that have become even cooler, smarter, and more cunning!

Controls:
Desktop: Mouse: select plants, click buttons, place plants, use bonuses, collect items.  
Mobile: Finger: select plants, click buttons, place plants, use bonuses, collect items.

Key Features:
• Selection: Combine plants to create unique species with their own abilities and appearances.  
• Challenges: Test your skills in various challenges that will provide new experiences and challenge your tactics.  
• Cheats: Cheats let you go wild: take as many sun points as you want and plant as many plants as you can.  
• Skins: You can purchase skins for your plants themed around popular memes.

Upgrades / Progression / Economy:
• Sun Points: The in-game currency that allows you to buy plants and place them in your garden. Sometimes they may fall from the sky, or sunflowers may give them to you. You can also obtain them by pressing the cheats button.  
• Dollars: In-game currency that can be spent on bonuses (e.g., cooldown-free gloves) or to buy new challenges. You can earn dollars by completing levels, from daily rewards, or by purchasing them with Gam.  
• Gam: Premium currency used to buy dollars or skins.

Game Modes:
• Adventure: A more classic mode with basic challenges. Completing a level in this mode unlocks a new one with tougher opponents and possibly a different appearance.  
• Challenges: A mode that offers new experiences. Each challenge can surprise you. For example, in one challenge, you can play as a zombie.

Characters / Heroes / Skins:
• Nut: Holds back zombies in front of you, buying time to fend off the attack.  
• It's fine Nut: A skin inspired by the "It's fine" meme.

Story / Setting:
The setting is a zombie apocalypse where hordes of zombies are trying to break into your home.

Core Gameplay & Story
Q: What is the goal of the game?  
A: The game is about defending your garden from hordes of zombies. Build defenses with various plants, devise unique tactics, and protect your garden from waves of monsters.

Q: How do you win / what counts as losing?  
A: Do not let the zombies break into your home. You need to prepare to fend off all waves and achieve victory.

Q: What grabs you in the first minutes?  
A: You can start combining plants right from the first minutes of the game, creating unique combinations. Each one can produce a special plant with its own abilities and distinctive traits.

Mechanics & Progression
Q: How many levels are there / is the structure clear?  
A: You will find many levels: from quite familiar to levels with special challenges. Completing a level unlocks a new one, and so on.

Q: What unlocks as you play?  
A: As you progress through the game, new levels with tougher opponents become available.

Q: Does the difficulty change?  
A: Yes, you can adjust the difficulty in the game based on your readiness.

Q: How can I level up faster?  
A: The game features free progression. Thanks to the cheat feature, you can give yourself as much currency as you want. With it, you can buy plants to defend your garden, so there are no barriers to how many plants you want to purchase.

Economy & Customization
Q: What can you buy/improve?  
A: You can buy bonuses and skins in the game. For example, a time acceleration x3 or a skin for a plant.

Q: Are there skins / customization?  
A: Yes, you can purchase various skins for your plants in the game.

Q: What is available from the start?  
A: Most plants in the game are available from the start, allowing for great opportunities for unique combinations from the first levels.

Retention & Engagement
Q: Is sound necessary?  
A: You can play without sound. The game is intuitive, so sound is not essential. However, with sound, you will immerse yourself better in the world.

Q: Is there onboarding in the game? What is it like?  
A: Yes, there is a brief tutorial at the beginning that provides basic knowledge. It does not overwhelm with information. After that, you immediately start playing a level, testing your knowledge in practice and discovering new possibilities.

title: Age of Heroes
description:
Build a hero army, defend towers and conquer eras in Age of Heroes!

Welcome to Age of Heroes — a world where heroes are born, armies march through eras, and every battle decides the fate of an empire. 

Lead an army, build fortresses, and guide your warriors to victory in epic battles from ancient times to the future. RPG elements and tower defense battles await you across eras, wars, and legendary castle sieges! 

Gather an army, develop heroes, protect every tower, and lead your knights through the ages — from ancient battles to futuristic warfare. Each era brings a new battle, a new tower, a new evolution. 

LEAD HEROES TO VICTORY 

You are the strategist and commander who decides the outcome of every battle. 
Create a squad of heroes and pets, combine the power of knights, mages, and warriors from different eras. 
Develop tower defense tactics and strike first. 
• Tactical battles and diverse game modes 
• Tower defense elements and fortress attacks 
• PvP battles between top teams 
• Heroes from different eras ready to fight for territories 

ERAS, CENTURIES AND THE EVOLUTION OF WAR

title: Plants vs Zombies Fusion Mode
description:
Welcome to the updated world of Plants vs. Zombies, where innovation is intertwined with tradition!

In this game, you have the opportunity not only to defend your home from zombies with the help of an army of plants, but also to create unique hybrid plants that combine the abilities of two or more original plants.

These hybrids give you unlimited tactical options to fight new waves of zombies that have become smarter, stronger, and more cunning!

Controls:
Desktop: Mouse: select plants, click buttons, place plants, use bonuses, collect items.  
Mobile: Finger: select plants, click buttons, place plants, use bonuses, collect items.

Key Features:
• Crossbreed Plants!: Combine plants to create unique specimens! They will surprise you with their appearance and abilities, and can pose a serious threat to zombies!  
• Meme Skins.: Dress your plants in skins. Some are inspired by popular memes!

Upgrades / Progression / Economy:
• Sun Points.: Earn them through sunflowers and purchase plants in-game to strengthen your defense!  
• Dollars.: Earn them by completing levels! You can use them to buy bonuses, challenges, and special plants in the shop!  
• Premium Currency.: Purchase special skins for your favorite plants!

Game Modes:
• Adventure: Defend your home by fending off waves, level by level, and defeat bosses by planting an unbreakable defense with your plants!  
• Challenges: Special levels with unique trials. Play as zombies or fend off monster attacks using only plants from gifts — you never know which plant you’ll get! There are challenges for every taste.

Characters / Heroes / Skins:
• Cabbage Pult: A plant that launches a cabbage head straight at zombies. The enemy won't know what hit them when it lands on their head!  
• Torch Wood: Helps turn projectiles launched by other plants into fiery ones! Roast those monsters!

Enemies / Bosses:
• Zombie Door.: Look out. This zombie had the clever idea to take a door and use it as a shield! I wonder what he'll do when your plants break it.  
• Super Driver Zombie.: Beware! This zombie is charging straight at you. Destroy him quickly before he crushes your plants! Deal as much damage as you can, and fast!

Story / Setting:
The zombie apocalypse has begun. The world is crawling with monsters eager for brains! Protect your home by planting living plants!

Core Gameplay & Story  
Q: What is the goal of the game?  
A: The zombie apocalypse has arrived! Zombies are taking over this world. Your plants can stop them! Plant your backyard defense to keep them from reaching your home!

Q: How do you win / what counts as losing?  
A: Don’t let the zombies into the house! Plant lines of defense with different plants to stop them and destroy all waves of monsters!

Q: What hooks you in the first few minutes?  
A: The pleasant music immerses you in this world. And if you find yourself short on plants, you can create unique species by combining them! They will differ not only in appearance but also in abilities!

Mechanics & Progression  
Q: How many levels are there / is the structure clear?  
A: Levels follow one after another, keeping boredom at bay. Each new level will introduce you to new plants and enemies!

Q: Does the difficulty change?  
A: Each subsequent level is harder than the last. You’ll need to strategize your defense and crossbreed plants to withstand the zombie onslaught!

Q: How can you level up faster?  
A: Plant more sunflowers! They give you sun points, which you can use to buy plants for your defense. Don’t hold back. Zombies won’t spare any effort to break through to you!

Q: What unlocks as you progress?  
A: New plants, along with new combinations, which will give you unique species with their own abilities.

Economy & Customization  
Q: What can you buy/improve?  
A: Purchase bonuses that will help you in the game. For example, speed up the game by 3 times if you want a faster pace. Special plants are also available in the shop.

Q: Are there skins / customization?  
A: Unlock skins for your plants! Many of them are themed around popular memes. Even zombies won’t be indifferent to them!

Q: What is available from the start?  
A: The Peashooter and Sunflower. The most basic plants, but indispensable in battle. Sunflowers will provide you with sun points to buy new plants, while the Peashooter is your loyal and brave guardian. It shoots peas and stops zombies trying to get into the house.

Retention & Engagement  
Q: Are there daily rewards / a wheel of fortune / achievements / tasks?  
A: Earn daily rewards for logging in! It’s always nice to return, as a surprise awaits you!

Q: Is sound necessary?  
A: Want to play in silence? No one will stop you from doing that.

Q: Is there onboarding in the game? What is it like?  
A: The first levels of the game will introduce you to all the mechanics and plants, so you can quickly understand how to build your defense effectively. You’ll grasp everything within the first levels!

title: Plants vs Zombies Hybrids
description:
A new era of Plants vs. Zombies has arrived — blending the best of the old with exciting new mechanics.

Build your defenses like never before by creating hybrid plants, each combining the abilities of multiple classic plants. With these powerful crossbreeds at your command, you'll face smarter, stronger, and more devious zombie hordes.

Controls:
Desktop: Mouse — select plants, click buttons, place plants, use bonuses, collect items.  
Mobile: Finger — select plants, click buttons, place plants, use bonuses, collect items.

Key Features:
• Combine Plants: Merge different plants to create unique species with their own abilities and appearances. This will significantly boost your defense against the undead!
• Cheats!: You can purchase plants for your defense during gameplay using sun points. Don’t worry about running out of plants. Just hit the Cheats button and get a ton of sun points instantly without limits!
• Various Zombies: You will face many zombies, and some may surprise you. Be well-prepared for their arrival!

Upgrades / Progression / Economy:
• Sun Points: Earn them from sunflowers or simply collect them during levels. You can use them to buy plants during battles. Press the Cheats button to get an unlimited amount!
• Dollars: Collect them during levels and purchase items in the shop or new challenges!

Game Modes:
• Adventure: The basic mode. Here, you will progress through levels one after another, fending off waves of zombies eager to invade your home. Each level will be more challenging, with larger and more dangerous waves of the undead!
• Challenges: Test yourself in various challenges! Play as a zombie or, for example, take on the glove challenge! And that’s not all. You can also buy new challenges with in-game currency.

Characters / Heroes / Skins:
• Cactus: The sniper in your garden! Shoots spikes directly at zombies. A fantastic marksman!
• Squash: One jump on a zombie — and it’s gone! A great option for quickly eliminating the undead!

Enemies / Bosses:
• Backup Dancer: He runs straight for the plants with a pole and jumps over the first plants. This could be a problem for you!
• Pea Shooter: Zombies can shoot too! Instead of a head, he has a living pea, and this plant is definitely not on your side. Destroy this zombie quickly!

Story / Setting:
The world is overrun by zombies! They are everywhere. Only your home and garden remain safe, but the zombies won’t let that stand. Protect your home from the undead with living plants!

Core Gameplay & Story  
Q: What is the goal of the game?  
A: Build a defense with living plants and protect your home from hordes of zombies that have taken over this world! Combine plants to create an effective defense and merge them together to obtain unique species!

Q: How do you win / what constitutes a loss?  
A: Don’t let the zombies breach your defense and invade your home! Destroy all waves of the undead attacking you!

Q: What grabs attention in the first few minutes?  
A: A vast array of plants and different types of zombies! Each plant has its own abilities and unique appearance! Meanwhile, zombies can have their own capabilities too. An epic battle will unfold right in your garden!

Mechanics & Progression  
Q: How many levels are there / is the structure clear?  
A: Levels follow one after another, and each can differ in features and appearance. In some, you will even have to fight at night!

Q: Does the difficulty change?  
A: Each level will be harder. Zombies will be better prepared, and with each new wave, there will be more of them! Combine plants, strategize, and fend off the attacks!

Q: How can I level up faster?  
A: You have a Cheats button. Press it and get as many sun points as you want! With sun points, you can buy plants for defense right in the level. Build your defense without limits!

Q: What unlocks as you play?  
A: New levels with different conditions and constantly increasing difficulty will unlock for you, and you will also be able to open new levels in challenge mode!

Economy & Customization  
Q: What can be bought/upgraded?  
A: Head to the shop and purchase bonuses, such as a shovel — with it, you can dig up unwanted plants, a skin pack for plants, and other useful bonuses and items!

Q: Are there skins / customization?  
A: Dress your plants in skins. Defending against the undead should also be stylish!

Q: What is available from the start?  
A: Most plants in the game are available from the start. You can immediately build a powerful defense with strong plants and merge them together!

Retention & Engagement  
Q: Are there daily rewards / a wheel of fortune / achievements / tasks?  
A: Collect daily rewards for a full 50 days! Each day in the game, you will be delighted with new rewards for an extended period. It’s always nice to return to the game when a gift awaits you!

Q: Is sound necessary?  
A: Sound is not mandatory, but if you turn it on, you can hear the legendary music and immerse yourself in the zombie apocalypse world.

Q: Is there onboarding in the game? What is it like?  
A: Everything will become clear right away. You will be taught how to play, and you will quickly get into the process.

title: Age of Tanks Warriors: TD War
description:
Lead Your Tank Warriors to Glory Across Time!
Welcome to Age of Tank Warriors: TD War, the ultimate tank warriors strategy game! Travel through the ages of war, leading your tank army from Stone Age warriors to the sci-fi space future. Upgrade your battle tanks, engage in intense Clash of Tank Warriors battles, and use tower defense (TD) strategy to conquer every era. 100vs100 survival battles await—will you rewrite history and become the greatest tank warlord?

title: AOD - Art Of Defense
description: AOD - Art Of Defense is a dynamic tower defense game with elements of strategy and RPG in a post-apocalyptic world.

title: Plants vs Zombies Fusion Nightmare
description:
Welcome to the ruins of the suburban zone, where the old rules no longer apply. You are not a gardener. You are the Chaos Dispatcher.

 The zombies have mutated, now moving stealthily, attacking from the sky, and hacking into your turrets. The only way to survive is to create hybrid mutants from the scraps of plant DNA. Chimeras that carry the fury of the Pea Farmer and the coldness of the Recidivist Cactus.

 Forget the "plant and water" tactic. Here, every hybrid is a crime against nature, and it's worth it.

title: Defender: Tanks Merge
description: Defender: Tanks Merge is a thrilling online strategy game where you create a powerful army by merging unique tanks with abilities. Face increasing waves of enemies, using auto-merge, bombs, and mines to strengthen your tactics. Play for free on desktop or mobile and enjoy hours of strategic fun!

title: Idle Airport Tycoon
description: Idle Airport Tycoon is a casual simulation game that puts you in charge of building and managing your very own bustling airport. Start with a humble airstrip and turn it into a world-class travel hub—move over Atlanta airport; we're looking to be the busiest airport in the world now! Upgrade everything from planes to terminals, unlock new revenue streams, and watch your profits soar! Are you ready to take on the challenge and become the ultimate airport tycoon?

title: Epic Empire: Tower Defense
description:
Immerse yourself in a dynamic tower defense strategy game where you must defend your kingdom from waves of goblins, ogres, and epic bosses. Control three heroes simultaneously, build defensive towers, and empower them with runes and pets. Explore diverse worlds—from icy kingdoms to underground tunnels—and prove your skill in tournaments.

Well-thought-out leveling, a variety of modes, and large-scale battles make the game an excellent choice for fans of tactics, base defense, and PvE challenges.


Core Gameplay & Story

Q: What is the game about? What needs to be done?
A: It is a Tower Defense game where you need to free the kingdom and level up your heroes.

Q: Is there a storyline in the game?
A: There is no specific storyline, but the objective is crystal clear.

Q: What is the unique feature of the game? What can hook players?
A: The game offers a wide variety of enemies, heroes, and related mechanics.

Q: Are there bosses, and how are they different?
A: Yes, bosses are much stronger than regular mobs and pose a serious challenge to the player.

Q: What currencies are there and what can they be spent on (regular - gold, premium - crystals, etc.)?
A: The game features gold for in-game sessions and rubies for character upgrades.

Q: How does leveling up work exactly? What needs to be done to level up faster?
A: To level up, you need to replay levels multiple times, increasing the difficulty and rewards. Leveling up unlocks new skills and abilities.

Q: What engaging content elements are there (weapons, vehicles, locations, skills, references to famous franchises, etc.)?
A: Yes, there are references to fantasy worlds, a variety of enemies, and mechanics.

Q: Are there daily rewards or something similar to encourage players to come back?
A: Yes, there are not only rewards but also special challenge levels.

Q: Is it preferable to play with sound to better immerse oneself in the atmosphere, or will there be difficulties in passing without sound?
A: The music in the game is not mandatory, but it enhances the atmosphere.

Q: Is the number of levels clear? How many are there? (dash if unclear)
A: There are at least 30 levels in the game, including daily challenges.

title: Chicken Merge 2
description: Chicken Merge 2 is a merge-meets-tower-defense game where your feathered army stands between your base and endless waves of enemies! Train, upgrade, and merge your chickens to create powerful defenders, then position them strategically on the battlefield. The stronger your flock, the better weapons and upgrades you’ll unlock! Can your ultimate chicken squad hold the line?

title: Kingdom Defender - Tower Defense
description:
Get ready for an exciting adventure where you must defend your kingdom from hordes of orcs, trolls, evil undead, and other vile creatures using towers and special abilities!

Fight in forests, mountains, and deserts, adapting your defensive strategy to the conditions with various upgrades and tower abilities! Summon flames beneath your enemies feet or freeze them, call in reinforcements, and battle legendary monsters to protect the kingdom from dark forces!

GAME FEATURES:
• Epic defensive battles that can captivate you for hours on end
• A variety of special tower upgrades and abilities to help you change your strategy
• Different enemies with unique skills, ranging from goblins to mighty undead
• Intense boss fights never before seen in the tower defense genre
• Extra difficulty levels that challenge your tactical skills
• Built-in encyclopedia with descriptions of towers and special abilities

title: Epic Battle Simulator 2
description:
Epic Battle Simulator 2  — Strategies, Armies, and Tactics in a New Format!
Develop unique strategies, choose your troops, and place them wisely on the battlefield to defeat any opponent. Fight campaigns against levels or create your own battles in custom mode.   

Now you can fully upgrade your army and witness realistic physics and ragdoll effects. Thanks to advanced graphics and enhanced AI bots, you’ll dive into thrilling large-scale battle simulations! Are you ready to take on the challenge and lead your army to victory? 
   
Features: 
- Realistic physics and ragdoll effects!  
- Improved army placement system for precise tactics!  
- Army upgrades up to three levels with powerful gear and enhanced stats!  
- Refined graphics that make every battle more spectacular than ever!  
- Smart troops for the most realistic combat simulation possible!

title: Mafia Wars
description: Mafia Wars is an action-packed shooting game where you play as a cowboy vigilante who fights against the corruption of mafia. Play engaging and immersive levels with various kinds of bosses. You must be careful with how you use your bullets, as saving them will come in handy in difficult battles.

title: We not survive
description: We Not Survive is a thrilling tower defense game in a zombie-infested, post-apocalyptic setting. As the sole defender, protect your base from relentless foes by playing online for free. Upgrade weapons and resources, unlock skills, and prepare for intense battles against waves of undead. Are you ready to survive?

title: Tower Defense
description: A horde of horrible monsters is attacking your kingdom, build your towers fast and survive all the waves. If arrows or stones are not enough, use elements to your advantage and slay them all.

title: Homo Evolution
description: Welcome to Homo Evolution, an enchanting journey where you can create your own little universe and unravel the mysteries of human evolution. This free online game lets you merge two individuals to birth a new, more modern life form, populating the planet with a wide array of creatures—from simple animals to diverse and unpredictable personalities. Whether you're on the phone or computer, this captivating gameplay invites you to shape the world in four unique ways, from the BEGINNING with animal evolution, to the BREAD civilization, witnessing the transformation from natural to modified products.

title: Jurassic Merge: Dino Evolution
description:
"Jurassic Merge: Dino Evolution" is an exciting game where you can create and upgrade dinosaurs by merging them to reach their maximum power! 🦖💥 Engage in epic battles, develop your creatures, and become a master strategist in this thrilling Jurassic world. ⚔️🧠

Game Features: 🔥 Dinosaur Evolution: Merge identical dinosaurs to create stronger creatures.
🛡️ Strategy: Place your army on the battlefield and use the right tactics to win.
💎 Upgrades: Earn crystals and gold to unlock new characters and enhance your creatures.
⚔️ Automatic Battles: Watch your dinosaurs fight against the enemy army.
🎮 Easy Controls: Simply drag and drop characters with the mouse or swipe on mobile devices.

Free game in the style of "Elemental Monsters: Merge & Evolve" and "Dino World: Merge & Fight". Win, upgrade your dinosaurs, and become the most powerful creature on the battlefield! 🦕💪

title: Zombie Horde: Build & Survive
description: Defend your base from hordes of zombies by shooting them with various weapons and placing turrets, barricades and traps

title: Your Majesty - Build & Conquer
description: "Your Majesty - Build & Conquer"  is an exciting strategy game that transports you to a world of kingdoms, where your task is to restore the greatness of your empire. Take on the role of a monarch who must revive a ruined settlement, turning it into a thriving capital, and expand your territories by conquering new lands.

title: Summon Tribe
description: Summon Tribe is a simple merge-and-defense game where you combine identical units to create stronger ones to stop enemies. It’s easy, mostly for passing time, and it also supports idle play.

title: Idle Tower Defense
description: Build your ultimate idle tower defense! Merge strategy, upgrades, and epic battles in this thrilling idle defense game. Protect your tower from endless waves of enemies in the best incremental game experience online!

title: Idle Tower Defense
description: Build your ultimate idle tower defense! Merge strategy, upgrades, and epic battles in this thrilling idle defense game. Protect your tower from endless waves of enemies in the best incremental game experience online!

title: 3D Chess - Arcane Edition
description:
Step into a mystical enchanted garden and play chess like never before.

3D Chess - Arcane Edition brings the classic strategy game to life with stunning 3D visuals, hand-crafted copper and gold pieces, and an immersive fairytale atmosphere. Challenge spirits across three difficulty levels — from casual fun to a serious test of skill.
Whether you're a beginner learning the game or a seasoned player looking for a quick match, this beautifully crafted chess experience is designed to captivate and challenge.

Available in 21 languages.

description:

title: Zombies ate my Castle
description: Zombies Ate My Castle is a tower defense game where you command an army of zombies to protect your fortress. Strategically deploy your undead allies, summon zombie carriers to revive fallen foes, and unleash powerful spells to turn the tide in battle. Collect coins from victories to upgrade your skills and boost your army. Can you save the zombie princess?

title: Rune Reactor
description:
Rune Reactor is a spell-building auto-battler where every rune changes your magic. Draft elemental and modifier runes,
combine them into powerful spells, and survive increasingly dangerous enemy waves. Collect gold and Arcane Dust,
discover rare combinations, defeat bosses, and unlock permanent upgrades for future runs.

title: Musketeers Gunpowder vs Steel
description: Musketeers: Gunpowder vs Steel is an exciting free-to-play strategy game set in the 17th century. Command a team of diverse soldiers, issuing orders and making vital choices during intense battles. Available on iOS, Android, and desktop, it’s ideal for fans of historical tactics.

title: Sneaker Factory!
description:
You're the owner of a sneaker factory! Will you be able to beat the competition and top the city ranking?

🔥 Fulfill orders – create sneakers on request: choose colors, apply labels and pack batches.

📦 Sorting in the warehouse – put the identical sneakers on the shelves.

🚚 Truck delivery – upgrade in driver mode: avoid obstacles and take the goods to the warehouse!

🏆 Leaderboard – Compete with other factories, earn a reputation and become No. 1!

Vivid graphics, dynamic gameplay and the excitement of production are waiting for you! Test your speed and business skills – start the game right now!

title: Clickdom
description: Welcome to Clickdom — a charming clicker where every tap brings your kingdom one step closer to glory! Wander through your realm, tap busy villagers to collect coins and scratch exciting lottery tickets for a chance to win magical scrolls and powerful buildings. Spend scrolls on kingdom upgrades and place new structures — a villager-collecting Tower, a resident-attracting Bell Tower and a coin-producing Laboratory — to automate your empire. Keep clicking, keep scratching and keep expanding until every upgrade is unlocked and your kingdom reaches its full potential. Can you build the ultimate Clickdom?

title: Millionaire Factory
description:
Millionaire Factory 🔩🏭 is a fun and addictive 🎉 clicker game where players collect Metal to grow their fortune. By tapping the giant Metal button 👆, players gather Metals, convert them into Money 💰, and invest in upgrades to build their own factory empire.

The game offers a growth journey that starts with a small piece of Metal 🔩 and expands into a massive factory and investment fortune 📈📉.

title: Survival Tycoon: City of Zombie
description:
Survival Tycoon: City of Zombie - Your Camp, Your Rules! 

You are the leader of a survivor group in the heart of a zombie apocalypse. This is a thrilling idle tycoon strategy where your goal is to protect the barrier, gather resources, and survive! A true survival simulator for those who love camp management and crushing hordes of enemies.
What awaits you:

✅ Trap Defense: Protect your barrier! Research and install deadly gear - from deadly spikes to massive decoy bombs!
✅  Relocation & Progress: Don't stay still! Move between motels and farms, upgrade your camp, and unlock new zones.
✅  Scavenging Runs: Send your team for fuel. It’s a classic survival strategy - every drop of gas counts!
✅  Camp Evolution: Develop your facilities, automate your income, and become the ultimate master of the wasteland!

Strengthen the barrier, gear up your scouts, and hit the gas. Become a survival legend right now!

title: Ant Colony Idle
description:
Ant Colony Idle is a relaxing incremental clicker game where you grow a tiny ant nest into a thriving underground colony. Tap the soil to find food, send workers to gather resources, and expand important chambers to boost your colony's income over time.

Unlock new food slots, upgrade rooms like the Food Storage, Nursery, and Queen Chamber, and keep improving your colony with powerful upgrades, cosmetic skins, achievements, and prestige bonuses.

Whether you play actively or let your ants keep working in the background, progress never stops. Start small, manage your nest wisely, and build the strongest ant colony possible.

title: Limited Defense
description: Play Limited Defense, a thrilling tower defense game! Command bandits, archers & explosive towers against waves of slimes, orcs & epic bosses. Upgrade defenses & unlock legendary heroes. Test your strategy now!

title: Pirates Merge: War Path
description: Pirates Merge: War Path is a strategy adventure where you combine swashbucklers to form a powerful army of ground and flying units. Complete 50 challenging missions across three regions, gathering coins and unlocking new upgrades as you go. Train, merge, and expand your forces to create an unstoppable pirate legion ready to conquer the seas.

title: Battle of Banners
description:
A war of banners on a hexagonal battlefield! In this turn-based medieval strategy you command a squad of knights, claim land, build camps, and shape the front line turn by turn. Every move matters: where to advance, which tile to block, whom to push back, and where to set an ambush by the forest or at a crossing. The winner is the one who expands faster than rivals and destroys their forces.

Play your way: locally on one device with friends, against bots for practice, or online — in duels and multiplayer matches. Maps with varied terrain change the tactics, and every match stays dynamic and fair: only you, your opponent, and your decisions.

title: SWAT and GREENS vs Zombies
description: Engage in SWAT and GREENS vs Zombies, a thrilling strategy game where you defend humanity from a zombie apocalypse. Enjoy online gameplay without downloads, equip over 50 unique weapons, and face endless undead waves. Test your skills in various modes and strive for victory in PvP battles.

title: Kingdom Defense Mega
description:
Kingdom Defense Mega.
Play the classic tower defense game. Build towers! Defend your kingdom! Use magic! Battle powerful enemies and fearsome bosses!
If you're a fan of the strategy genre, then Kingdom Defense is definitely for you.

title: Clash of Tanks
description: Clash of Tanks is real time strategy tank game. Objective is to destroy the opponent base by deploying the tanks. Each tank has its own weakness and strength, selecting the right tanks at appropriate time is best way to win the battle. Good Luck

title: Moon Chess
description: Moon Chess is a cosmic strategy game where you face off against the mysterious Half Moon! Connect the phases of the lunar cycle — from Crescent to Full Moon — to score points and outwit the shifting tides of light and shadow. Inspired by real astronomical phenomena, every move brings you closer to mastering the moon’s rhythm. Are you clever enough to outplay the lunar cycle itself?

title: Shadow Stick Ninja
description:
Shadowstick Ninja is a physics puzzle game with a dark, minimalist style. In this game, precision is more important than speed.

You play as a silent shadow ninja with only a few arrows. In each level, enemy ninjas hide behind obstacles and structures, waiting for you to take them out. Your goal is to eliminate every enemy. 

The way you do it is up to you!

Pull back, aim, and release to shoot arrows with the right trajectory. Pick from different arrow types and solve each level your own way:

- Regular arrows for clean, direct hits
- Bomb arrows to cause explosive area damage and break through obstacles
- Balloon arrows that attach to enemies and lift them into the air, exposing them for easier shots

There isn’t just one right answer. You can play smart and efficient, or try out new ideas and experiment as much as you want.

Lift an enemy into the air with balloons. Use lots of bombs just to see what happens. Try odd angles, mix up different moves, or come up with wild solutions.

Every arrow counts. If you run out of ammo, you’ll need to rethink your strategy and give it another shot.

Plan your moves, try bold ideas, and enjoy every physics-based takedown.

title: Strategy of war: Tanks and helicopters
description: War Strategy: Tanks and Helicopters is an engaging online strategy game where you lead forces to seize enemy strongholds. Play seamlessly on various devices without downloading. Enjoy tactical combat as you use tanks and helicopters to succeed in this skill-testing military challenge—no registration needed.

title: Love Sheep
description:
Love Sheep is a fun, quirky, and relaxing puzzle game you can enjoy anywhere.
Enter a world of bouncy, jelly soft sheep in a physics based adventure full of squish, stretch, and smart puzzles. 
If you like brainy challenges but also want cozy, relaxing vibes, Love Sheep is the perfect game for you.

title: Farm Business Saga
description:
Farm Business Saga is a captivating farming simulation game where players build and manage their dream farm. Perfect for nature lovers and strategy enthusiasts, this game lets you cultivate crops, raise livestock, produce goods, and expand your agricultural empire.
What makes Farm Business Saga unique?
✅ Addictive gameplay – Manage resources, trade, and grow into a farming tycoon.
✅ Stunning graphics & intuitive controls – A visually pleasing experience for all ages.
✅ Endless customization – Design your farm, village, and factory your way!
Whether you're a casual player or a strategic mastermind, Farm Business Saga offers a relaxing yet challenging farming adventure!

title: Lucky Clash
description: Lucky Clash is a fast-paced 3D tactical Tower Defense game where players summon powerful monsters, merge units, and defend their kingdom against relentless enemy waves. The game combines quick, easy-to-learn battles with strategic depth, letting players create strong teams, discover powerful relics, and use clever combinations to survive each challenge. Its unique mix of monster merging, elemental synergies, and dynamic battles makes every run feel different.

title: Find Visitors - 99 Nights
description:
Find Visitors - 99 Nights -  is an atmospheric game where you take on the role of the manager of a forest refuge. Let the forest creatures in and drive away the visitors.

Check for signs and identify hidden monsters – the visitors!

title: Trash Baron
description:
Trash Baron: Turn trash into treasure!

Have you ever thought that trash is not waste, but a resource? In Trash Baron, you will create a waste recycling empire. Start with a small landfill and turn it into a high-tech enterprise!

Gameplay:
♻️ Collect and sort: Tons of waste - plastic, glass, metal, and rubber. Sort it all properly.
🏭 Recycle into goods: start production lines! We turn plastic bottles into new bottles and so on
💰 Sell and grow: the higher the quality of your recycled products, the higher the profit. Earn money to buy new equipment, expand your workshops, and hire employees.
📈 Become a baron: from a small waste collection point to the largest waste recycling plant in the city. The future of the environment and business is in your hands!

title: Kingdoms Wars
description: Throw the dice and step into the Kingdoms Wars game! Monopoly alike, the objective of this board game is to travel around the globe, buying streets and building hotels onto them. Going to jail, pulling bonus cards, paying fees to the king, and paying overpriced when you stay at your competitor houses, are parts of the game. Collect rents, upgrade your hotels, and have fun traveling around!

title: Hospital Surgeon Doctor Game
description: Run a multi-specialty hospital and treat patients through fun, guided mini-surgeries. Diagnose illnesses, use medical tools, and perform heart, dental, eye, ENT, and orthopedic procedures by tapping and dragging instruments to the correct areas. Complete each treatment step in sequence, unlock new cases, and help patients recover. The game features simple touch controls, colorful visuals, and casual doctor-simulation gameplay for all ages.

title: My Tiny Market
description: In My Tiny Market, you're the boss of your very own supermarket. Manage your time and resources well to find the perfect balance between all your tasks: restock shelves, serve customers and keep everything running at full speed!

title: Neighborhood Defense
description: Neighborhood Defense is a dynamic tower defense strategy game where your mission is to protect your neighborhood from waves of zombies. Diverse maps with multiple exits, different types of enemies, and limited tower spots make each match unique. Upgrade your towers, combine their abilities, and plan your tactics carefully to stop the horde and prevent them from breaking through.

title: Tower Defenders
description: Fight the undead viking warriors and upgrade your defenses. Use the rewards you get for victories to your advantage. Hold out for as long as you can!

title: Monkey Bubble Defense
description:
Survive the bubble invasion in this fast-paced 2D top-down tower defense game. Construct and upgrade various defensive turrets to take down hordes of bubbles.

Earn cash by popping bubbles. Use cash to to purchase new towers, upgrade existing ones, or sell for cash and reinvest into a different turret.

title: Ultimate Tower Defense
description: Ultimate Tower Defense is an exciting strategy game that perfectly blends tower defense, battle, and fast-paced action into one addictive experience. In the game, you must carefully protect defense towers and deploy powerful heroes to stop endless waves of enemies. Each tower has unique attack abilities. Select your preferred mode to begin the challenge.

title: TimeWarriors
description:
Lead your army to glory through the ages! Embark on an epic journey through history. From primitive battles of the Stone Age to the futuristic wars of the future — become the greatest commander the world has ever known.

Become a great commander and lead your army to victory! Play “Time Warriors” now!

title: Conquer.io
description: Expand your zone and assert your dominance over every territory on the map. Plan your moves to outmaneuver opponents and gain as much space as possible. But beware, your rivals will stop at nothing to thwart your plans. Are you ready to claim your space?

title: Board Kings Board Dice
description: Board Kings: Board Dice is a classic multiplayer strategy board game. Do you like to play Monopoly,Board Kings: Board Dice is similar to Monopoly. Become the real Board King by building and upgrading your empire with dice points, building and upgrading your board, or infiltrating other players' boards and attacking their buildings. This is a game where luck and strength go hand in hand to win,how is your luck today? Join us for more surprises waiting to be unlocked!

title: My Little Farm
description: Welcome to My Little Farm! Roll up your sleeves and dive into the world of planting, harvesting, and selling to meet daily demands. Upgrade your tools, nurture your crops, and keep the farm flourishing. Can you handle the never-ending requests and become the ultimate farmer?

title: Sea Battle Admiral
description:
Do you remember your favorite childhood entertainment with paper and pencils?
Then, immerse yourself in the exciting sea battles on your device's screen.
The classic paper-based tabletop naval combat game is here!
Enjoy exciting naval battles, strategy, and adrenaline.

title: Noob Village Tower Defense
description: Dive into the dynamic world of a 2D platformer, where you play as a noob fighting for the survival of your village! Your main goal is to protect the village from endless waves of monsters appearing from an ominous portal. Control the tower manually: select shells, adjust the trajectory and shoot enemies one by one. Only your accuracy and tactics will help you survive the onslaught!

title: Count Escape Rush
description: Count Escape Rush plays like a 3D stickman running arcade game. Different from traditional running arcade games, your members will run backward and shoot the chasing enemies. With 3D stickman soldiers, you need to collect more members and weapons to fight incoming red enemies before you arrive at the finish line. Any obstacles will decrease your members or make you lose directly. Don't forget to pass the green numbered walls and collect weapons to increase your firepower.

title: Zombies Weapon Merge 4
description: Zombies are swarming. Are you ready to fight back? Zombies 4 – Weapon Merge is an exciting shooting and strategy game where every decision matters. Match and merge weapons to create powerful guns, then aim and shoot endless waves of zombies. Combine identical weapons, upgrade your firepower, and place them smartly to survive tougher enemies.

title: Ultimate Plants TD
description: Ultimate Plants TD is an army of plants to protect your garden from countless zombies. Your goal is to protect your garden from challenging waves of zombies. Experimenting with different plant combinations and positioning is the key to maximizing your defense capabilities and overcoming tough challenges!

title: Cannons Blast 3D
description: Cannons Blast 3D plays like another tower defense puzzle game. With a heavy machine gun and a cannon, you need to eliminate all incoming enemy units before they get close to your castle. Your weapon has limited ammo and reloading speed. It is necessary to make a choice of fire coverage. When you earn enough gems, you can buy the other 2 weapons and upgrade your current ones. It is time to test your shooting skills!

title: Gold Miner Tower Defense
description: Gold Miner Tower Defense is a wonderful combination of tower defense, card strategy and upgrade combat. You will play as a brave miner protecting gold from enemies. Protect your precious treasures strategically with many unique defense towers!

title: Plants Vs Zombies War
description: Plants Vs Zombies War is based on the famous PC game called Plants VS Zombies. This tower-defense strategy game needs your plans to fight against 15 kinds of incoming zombies. You can check the consumption and attack of all of your 15 plants before the battle. Then the tutorial will show the basic rules and plants at Level 1. The more levels you complete, the more plants you can unlock. You could also unlock them from ads in advance.

title: Musketeers Gunpowder vs Steel
description: Take command in Musketeers: Gunpowder vs Steel, a strategic 17th-century battle experience. Lead musketeers, pikemen, and reiters as a mercenary commander, issuing orders, engaging in combat, and training troops. Master tactics, crush your enemies, and claim victory on the battlefield.

title: Plant Girl Defense Zombie
description: Plant Girl Defense Zombie is a tower-defense shooting strategy game. With 2D cartoon plant girls and zombies, you need to defeat all of the zombies in 24 levels. Change the launching track and select skills when you level up. Different from the traditional Plants VS Zombies series, you don't need to build many plants to fight against zombies. You only need to control one plant to shoot. Good luck!

title: Clash of Heroes
description:
Create your team and attack other kingdoms, defeat the opposing troops, destroy their castles and lead your team to victory.
Each victory will earn you medals, experience and gold with which you can upgrade your troops and your castle so you can face stronger and stronger enemies.
Travel through different territories and conquer them all!

title: Drawer Sort
description: Do you like a cluttered space exactly where everything has its place? It is time to organize your life and become a tidying hero, conquering chaos one drawer at a time.  Be sure to plan ahead for this epic puzzle or you may find yourself with a messier hand than when you started! Each brain training task will challenge you to place various items in the right places. You'll have to aim for perfect precision if you want to make sure the objects fit snugly and achieve the ultimate tidy victory.

title: Politon
description: Politon is a turn-based strategy game with easy-to-understand mechanics and satisfying visuals. If you want to test your strategical logic against enemies of different numbers and difficulty levels, Politon offers a variety of hex-based maps with various terrains. You'll need to manage your economy while expanding your territories and defend your region against rival invasions.

title: Toy Assembly 3D
description:
Assemble a wide variety of brick buildings and scenes in this classic constructor game. Start as a baby builder and level your way up to increasingly complex construction sets. This relaxing and
satisfying game is sure to bring you back to the imagination and fun of your childhood!  Find the right piece and simply tap to add it to your build.  Get hands-on fun without the clutter or accidentally stepping on toys.

title: Horror Minecraft Partytime
description: Horror Minecraft Partytime is a spooky and interesting horror survival game. This time you will enter a familiar world of blocks. In this hide-and-seek mode, you will be the pursuer, looking for every corner. Find the weirdo in disguise and catch him.

title: Collect Honey Puzzle
description:
Collect Honey Puzzle is a popular and favorite merge game. You are now in charge of collecting honey, but you need to slowly upgrade to collect it. You can start by collecting sticks and
upgrading to bricks. Upgrade from one brick to three and then to the honey jar and finally collect the honey successfully.  You can also challenge your highest record anytime, and anywhere. If you are interested in this game, join us!

title: Limited Defense
description:
Limited Defense is a strategic tower defense game where you command bandits, archers, and explosive towers to hold back relentless waves of enemies. Face off against mischievous Green Slimes, fearsome Orcs, and towering bosses like the Boss King Slime. Upgrade your defenses, unlock legendary warriors, and test your tactical skills in intense, fast-paced battles!
Can you make it in this tower defense game?

title: Stickman Guys Defense
description:
Stickman Guys Defense is an action-packed tower defense game where you must protect your base from endless waves of enemies! Command a team of brave stickman warriors, place them strategically, and upgrade their abilities to stop the invasion. From archers to sword fighters, build the ultimate defense and survive each level!

Can you defend your land and become the ultimate Stickman commander?

title: Finger Heart Monster Refill
description:
Do you love Finger Heart posing? Do you want to make Finger Heart with a cute character? Let's Play This Game. In Finger Heart: Monster Refill, you must choose how to fit your finger with other
adorable monsters to form a perfect heart. To fill a perfect heart, you don’t need any special skills, just use your imagination and creativity.  They can change its shape in many ways. You'll need to think carefully about which form fits the shape of your fingers. Come make hearts with cute monsters!

title: Skeleton Defense
description: Soldier Youre the last hope for humanity Its up to you to stop the waves of undead skeletonsFeatures Interactive tutorial to learn the ropes  different weapons Use rifles grenades rockets Molotov cocktails and other impressive weapons to stop these skeletons  different skeleton types Unlimited gameplay A shop to upgrade and unlock new weapons

title: Mech Monster Arena
description: Mech Monster Arena is a robot-fighting turn-based strategy game. Differently in this fighting game, you don't need to learn how to operate the robot and release each skill. You only need to learn the basic skill counter rules and select the skills flexibly. By earning EXPs and coins from battles in Mech Battle, you can fight with AI opponents and develop your robot. When you have some sources to upgrade your robot in the Mech Warehouse, you can challenge other players in the Arena. Have fun!

title: Crown & Cannon
description: Crown & Cannon is a fast-paced 2D strategy game where players expand territory, deploy various weapons, and battle dynamic AI on destructible terrain. It features upgradeable units, strategic combat, and is optimized for Web platforms and cross platform.

title: Tank Stars Battle Arena
description: Tank Stars - Battle Arena is a tank design strategy game with 2D models. In 14 levels, we need you to build tanks to defeat all enemy tanks. As long as you defeat the enemy pilot, you can win the battle. When you earn enough diamonds, you can open the chests for tank parts in the Shop. You can save at most 3 projects of the tank design. Don't forget to change the positions of different parts, they have different functions.

title: The Counterfeit Bank
description:
The Counterfeit Bank: Fake Money Tycoon Simulator
Think Plague Inc, but with counterfeit cash! Your goal: dominate the economy one fake note at a time.
Taxes are soaring, inflation’s out of control, and recession looms—perfect chaos for your evil plan. Print counterfeit money, outsmart enforcers, and flood the market with fake cash to disrupt the system.
Can you survive the chaos and take over the economy before time runs out? Mwahahaha!

title: Christmas Castle
description: Christmas Castle is a free christmas match  game Drag christmas items to create a line of  or more matching christmas items Matching more than  produces special bonuses up to  matching in a row Making a match increases the time you have remaining Make matches quickly to ensure you do not run out of time Have fun

title: Side Defense
description: Get ready for a brand new defense game! Make your best score and show your skill in an endless game. If balls touch the lower course, you lose the game.

title: Idle Medieval: Tower Defense
description:
Idle Medieval: Tower Defense is a completely free game that challenges players to manage a tower and survive against endless waves of enemies for as long as possible. To endure, you'll have access to a variety of strategic powers—but use them wisely! Every decision matters, and choosing the right abilities at the right time is key to victory.

Each time you level up, you must choose one of four unique abilities, each offering distinct advantages. Your choices shape the course of the game, as the next level-up will enhance the selected ability, making it even more powerful. With the right strategy and skillful upgrades, you'll become stronger and better equipped to face increasingly difficult challenges.

Get ready for an addictive and thrilling experience where every decision could mean the survival or downfall of your tower. Do you have what it takes to become a legend in medieval tower defense?

title: Arena Heroes Tactics!
description: Hire, teach and equip warriors, customize and manage your own unique squad to explore Catacombs and fantasy Dungeons! Build the strongest team, create more combinations and make your personal strategy and fight against other players online on PvP Arena battles like traditional MOBA. Play Tournaments, take rewards and win epic chests in Championships! Challenge top players in online leaderboards! Or simple collect rewards from Dungeons, complete special Events and raid the Bosses - just chill out.

title: Mini Colony
description: Mini Colony is yet another online game from the series, this time you’ll be building up your own small colony. You find yourself on arid islands, so survival won’t be that easy. Right at the beginning you will get 3 workers helping you out (they can chop wood for instance). Thanks to them, you will be able to enlarge your colony and buy new tools. The wood itself won’t be enough and you’ll have to find other resources that will allow you to thrive. Food is also very important, so be sure to quickly set up a farm and care for your animals. There’s a ton of options, so don’t worry about getting bored.

title: Mini Farm
description: Mini Farm is a great online game where you will be helping your little farmer take care of the whole farm. Aside from growing crops and fishing, you will have to take care of many animals, such as pigs, cows or even sheep. For the money you earn, you will be able to purchase more animals or crops and make your farm larger. Aside from that you can also improve your accommodations and buy new furniture. You earn money by selling crops and produce in the city. The game provides you with a ton of options, so be sure to explore quite a bit! We are pretty sure you won’t be bored.

title: Tavern Master
description: Build a tavern from the ground up in any way you imagine it! It can be a classy place meant to serve kings or a restaurant which specializes in great food. Optimize your seating arrangement to allow your staff to be as fast as possible, upgrade and expand to attract even more patrons and spread your business to include a hotel, a weapon shop and maybe even a medieval food delivery service! In order to keep your customers happy you will need to have enough food and drinks at all times, efficient staff, great decorations and proper lights. Combine all of that with your imagination and your tavern might be the best in the kingdom!

title: Business Tycoon
description: Business Tycoon is a strategy game where you’ll have to build up your own store empire. You start off with a single store and you’ll have to do everything yourself. As you progress, you start buying upgrades that will improve the sum of money you earn. After a while, you can buy more upgrades or hire managers who will be taking care of the cash flow. This way, you can improve the stores and earn more revenue. The goal will be to buy up all of the stores and create an empire.

title: Last Debt
description: Last Debt is an interesting simulator where you're trying to make as much many as possible to pay a really high debt. At the beginning of the game you are able to pick how high the debt will be and the time that you need to pay it in. From that stems the game difficulty. Aside from all that you need to take care of your own needs. Try to be healthy, well fed and in good condition both physically and mentally. At the beginning of the game you start in a fast food, but the game is offering you other jobs as well.

title: Defentures
description: The game is inspired by Kingdom rush and Age of War. In this game, you are building your kingdom and attacking the present enemy units. You need to find a way how to get as far as possible. Protect yourself and attack whenever the enemy least expects it. Find a way how to win, there’ll be a ton of options available for you, so be ready to have fun!

title: MineClicker
description: MineClicker is an online game where you’ll be killing different types of animals and mining blocks. For each animal, you earn points that can then be used to buy different upgrades or to hire up a new companion that will help you out. The blocks can be used to buy new weapons that will allow you to kill faster. The more companions and the better weapons you have, the faster you’ll progress in the game. Will you be able to slay the famous Enderdragon?

title: City Tycoon
description: City Tycoon is an online building game where you will be tasked with building up your city. Right at the beginning of the game, you will be able to set up the size of your map. Don’t be a megalomaniac though, it’s better to start small and expand with each play-through. Also, the game might start lagging if your city gets too large. The terrain can be adjusted to your needs. Terrain elevation can also be adjusted. Then, there are some buildings that you might build. You can also build on water. The most important thing is to have a flat terrain base. Don’t forget to build roads connecting the buildings so that cars can drive there. It’s an interesting online game, where you can build up the whole city according to your imagination, so come try it out!

title: Strong Defense
description: In today's online game, you'll be playing as an archer tasked with a very important objective. You'll be guarding the castle gates against a never-ending horde of enemies. The enemy lines include monsters like trolls that will move slowly or flying creatures that will be more difficult to hit. So try concentrate as much as you can and don't forget to buy upgrades, since they can make the odds of winning better!
